description: This file implements a watchdog driver for Infineon XMC4xxx microcontrollers within the Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, interrupt handling, and feeding the watchdog.

methods.name: wdt_xmc4xxx_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for watchdog warning events, handles clearing the event, invoking callback, and servicing the watchdog if needed.

methods.name: wdt_xmc4xxx_setup
methods.description: Configures the watchdog timer with options such as sleep and debug modes.

methods.name: wdt_xmc4xxx_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a timeout configuration for the watchdog, including setting window bounds and callback.

methods.name: wdt_xmc4xxx_feed
methods.description: Feeds (resets) the watchdog timer to prevent it from expiring.

methods.name: wdt_xmc4xxx_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog device, sets up IRQ, and installs default timeout if not disabled at boot.

methods.name: wdt_xmc4xxx_irq_config
methods.description: Configures the interrupt for the watchdog warning event.
